data.name: Project: Deimos
data.detailed_description:
In this first-person survival thriller game, play as the sole survivor of a catastrophic crash on an alien planet. Stranded, you must explore uncharted lands, forage for anything that can help, and fight to find your way back to Earth.

This is Astro-Bio

Play as Caroline, an expert astro-biologist recruited for a mission to accompany the mighty ship Pandora to monitor its cargo of alien botanical samples. Or at least, that’s what you were told… Learn to survive on the alien world with your unique knowledge, and uncover the true nature of your mission along the way. 

Traverse the Alien World 

Watch out! This unfamiliar planet may be less than kind to strangers. Climb to higher ground and plan out your routes, searching through the debris of the Pandora for anything of use.   

Flora

With your rations destroyed in the crash, your only means of finding sustenance lay in the dense forest around you. Identify the unique characteristics of the world's flora and use them to your advantage.

Fauna

Pioneer humanity's first (and completely accidental) discoveries of alien macroorganisms -- but as any good biologist knows: when encountering the unknown, you must be careful…

data.short_description: Crash landing on an alien planet, you must use your knowledge as a Biologist to navigate the strange fauna and evade dangerous predators. Salvage whatever you can and find your way out in this First Person Survival Horror game. Be wary: you may not be the only thing that survived the crash...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 450 GTS / Radeon HD 5750 or better
  • Storage: 1800 MB available space
